svg.title: Fetal Health Analysis — project workflow
svg.desc: Full pipeline from raw data inputs through five ML/DL models to the LangChain AI assistant and clinical response, delivered via FastAPI and React.

g.text: Risk level · Fetal state · Scan plane · Head & abdomen masks · Grad-CAM heatmap

g.text: Retrieves indexed medical guidelines · fuses ML outputs into context window
Conversational memory · prompt engineering · LLM response generation
